hook: ChatGPT gave me a 5-step plan when I needed someone to just tell me what to do.
caption:
ChatGPT gave me a 5-step plan when I needed someone to just tell me what to do.

I was overwhelmed. Deadline in 2 hours. I typed out my whole situation and asked for help.

It came back with:
✦ Step 1: Assess your priorities
✦ Step 2: Break tasks into smaller chunks
✦ Step 3: Eliminate distractions

Bro. I KNOW. That's why I'm asking you.

Here's the thing — AI defaults to "balanced and comprehensive" because it has no idea if you're a person who wants options or a person who wants a verdict.

Some people need the full framework. Others need someone to just pick a lane and say GO.

The AI can't tell the difference. So it hedges. Every time.

The fix isn't a better prompt. It's teaching the AI which type of thinker you are — once — so it stops giving you a self-help book when you need a decision.

That's exactly what a BootFile does. It tells AI: this person is a decisive executor, not a deliberate planner. Skip the scaffolding.

Once it knows that? The response changes completely.

What's your AI frustration — too many options, or not enough detail? Drop it below 👇
